description: Need cues, arm S only. A reading question (Vi-SQuAD, Vi-DROP, BiDLQA) that asks to compute or to combine facts from the passage goes to S, whatever its dataset; every other item stays on B.

conditions.note: reading question with a calculation_or_combination cue of cue-lexicon-v1; S cannot separate a reading failure from a reasoning one, so it targets both
